newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex sees 10 pct annual rise in op earnings.
newsitem.headline: Vendex sees 10 pct annual rise in op earnings.

text.p: Vendex International NV chairman Jan-Michiel Hessels said on Tuesday he was pleased with the group's performance in the first half of 1996/97, adding the firm was back on track for a 10 percent annual rise in operating earnings.

"The most important thing is that (Vendex) is back on track for a 10 percent annual increase in EBIT (earnings before interest and tax) excluding property," Hessels said at a news conference to announce the group's first half results.

Vendex net profit jumped 21 percent to 151 million guilders in the six months ending July 31 and operating income rose 19 percent to 153 million guilders. Excluding redevelopment and sale of property, operating income rose 22 percent.
"I think the financial results were good, the quality of the earnings was good," Hessels said, adding that progress had also been made on the strategic front in terms of acquisitions.
